children.text: Build: engage accounts pace their daily pages across 24 h and re-bind a moved exit themselves
children.note:
Done when a full UTC day on prod reads the paced busiest-hour share at 0.10 or less, with every account bound (unbound 0, all 165 bound). 10-23 read 0.282: idle accounts spent their day in 3 to 4 evening hours while about 20 in-session accounts carried the day. Fix 9b25dd088e (on origin/sieun/dev): each account at most a 24th of its day per hour, background pages spread through the hour, and a canary's hour is its day divided by engage.canary_hourly_divisor. The 10-23 replay reads 0.073 at a divisor of 48 and 0.094 at 36, all 19,169 pages served, with openings about doubling (121 to 226 a day). Default 36 is in 685015b496 (on box sieun/dev): at 48 a canary would max near 1,000 a day, under the 1,167 the canary group read on 10-20, and at 36 it maxes near 1,333. Raising it to 2,000 later is one config row (24).
00:5xZ 10-28: the closing read of 10-27 FAILED, paced p50 0.157 over 23 accounts (153 active, 0 unbound). Every top hour falls in 06-08Z: 13.4k of 22.8k pages were sent in 06-09Z, because watch due times cluster (7,568 of 9,873 monitor tagged rows are due 04-09Z) and cadence keeps each cohort's phase. The pace held: the busiest watch_feed account-hour at 07Z averaged 15.5 pages (2,503 pages over 161 accounts). Job p98-watch-due-spread spreads the due times over 24 h by a stable per-target phase. Reads now go through Grafana grafana_ro ({w}p98-paced-grafana.sql).
09:3xZ 10-26: the watch is caught up on fa7ff27c82 (ae22adb415, live 08:28Z). Claims settle ok in a median of 24-122 s, 0 starved, 0 open. 0 of 9,894 monitor posts targets are due, and 9,204 ran in the last 24 h. Closing read: 10-27 at 10-28 00:20Z.
